content: Binbaş, as quoted, reports from the Kitāb-i Diyarbakriyya that in 872/1467-68 Jamāl al-Dīn Turka was among the pro-Turkmen notables of Isfahan, took the pro-Timurid Khvāja Jalāl al-Islām Ṣāʿidī hostage, and afterward supported Ḥasan-ʿAlī b. Jahānshāh; he is not heard of again. Melvin-Koushki says only that Jamāl al-Dīn 'may have been' a key player in the Timurid-Turkmen struggle.
